name: create_appointment
description: MUST call immediately after the caller explicitly confirms one offered slot. Pass caller_full_name from lookup_patient and copy practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time unchanged from that exact search_availability slot. Include patient_id when it is still available; Bolna Chat may omit it because caller_full_name can be resolved only when it exactly matches one patient. Never report a system error unless this tool was actually called and returned ok=false.

patient_id.description: Exact patients[].id UUID from lookup_patient when available. Optional only for Bolna Chat; never invent it.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.
